name: council-pane
description: Draws the claude-council streaming pane inside Claude Code

pane_host.title: Council pane opens in
pane_host.description: claude-code draws the pane inside Claude Code; tmux leaves it to the tmux pane; ask puts the question once inside tmux and remembers the answer.

collapse_when_done.title: Collapse status when done
collapse_when_done.description: Replace the provider list with a one-line summary once a run finishes.

wake_on_async_done.title: Wake when an async run finishes
wake_on_async_done.description: Submit a prompt when a background council run completes. Starts a model turn, which costs tokens.

council_tool.title: Council as a tool
council_tool.description: Let the model call the council as a tool. Off by default: the council sends your question to third-party providers, and a tool is easier to call unprompted than a slash command.
